connector.name: JobsPipe
connector.registryDescription: Live job postings from 30+ ATS feeds and job boards, one schema. Live results need a Bearer key.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.jobspipe.dev over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace dev.jobspipe, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer jp_live_<key> - create a free key at https://jobspipe.dev/signup (dashboard Settings -> API Keys).
